title: Rationality of a normal surface singularity passes to the completion, and the blowup of the maximal ideal has normal completions
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter resolve.tex (Resolution of Surfaces)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file resolve.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a two dimensional Nagata local normal domain defining a rational singularity with normal completion, the completion again defines a rational singularity and the completions of the local rings of the blowup of the maximal ideal at closed points are normal (statement lines 3052-3062). The proof (proof lines 3064-3110) turns the first assertion into a vanishing statement, spreads modifications from the completion to the original ring, transfers the vanishing by flat base change, and obtains the second assertion from normality of the blowups, excellency of the completion and an isomorphism of completions. H3: two assertions with several transfers of properties, written out in full.
